purpose: Local target-fitting diagnostic on two known TRAIN failures; distinguish continuous action-to-space decoder capacity, bounded feature capacity and residual bound. Never counted as learned action, prediction, generalization or goal completion.
loss: Unchanged v6 full/ROI over all10 and motion-weighted L1 over9 futures; no delta loss, no future latent supervision. Each branch sees exactly the same complete target RGB window.
future_access: Real RGB is used by the oracle optimizer and is explicitly not prediction. The unchanged posterior baseline retains its normal future-state encoder access. No additional direct true-future coordinates/features initialize or supervise oracle variables; they enter only the separately labeled teacher-state reference.
initialization: All three branches begin at the same exact selected posterior prediction, with baseline render parity. Each branch gets a fresh Adam optimizer. Endpoints use step100, never best-step selection.
decision: Report changes at h0 and each real future h separately. Continuous Z is a 64D relaxation and not legal LFQ; success cannot distinguish Qformer from LFQ. Bounded feature success proves a same-support construction exists for this case. Unbounded-only success motivates the residual parameterization. Finite-budget failure is not an impossibility proof.
stop: Native point or GPU memory guard
